claim: Mentra App account-switch deep-link security hotfix merged to staging
summary: MentraOS PR #4947 describes a phone companion-app account isolation flaw in reset and signup links: an opened link could replace the current signed-in account without consent, risking data association with a different account. The developer says 3.2 main shares the affected code. Staging fix merged October 25 00:31 UTC, with 138 upstream tests; production distribution, exploit reports, and independent device reproduction are not established.
